visual.general_description: Two electrocardiogram tracings, labelled A and B, on pink grid paper with printed lead labels.
visual.detailed_description: Two side-by-side paper ECG tracings with panel letters A and B printed below them. Panel A is a clean printout with calibration pulses and lead labels I, II, III, aVR, aVL, aVF, V1 to V6 and rhythm rows V1, II, V5. Panel B is a faded, creased paper tracing with the same lead labels. No numeric values, intervals, patient text or timestamps are printed.

panels.general_description: 12-lead electrocardiogram tracing on a pink grid with printed lead labels.
panels.detailed_description: Printed electrocardiogram on pink grid paper with a rectangular calibration pulse at the left of each row. Rows carry printed lead labels: I, aVR, V1, V4; II, aVL, V2, V5; III, aVF, V3, V6; then three longer rhythm rows labelled V1, II and V5. The panel letter A is printed below the tracing at the lower left.
